{{Top|leg}}
'''Education packs''' were learning modules that came installed in [[TTS-15 Series Tutorial Droid]]s. Each droid could be pre-installed with up to three packs on a variety of subjects including galactic history, material and theoretical sciences, languages, literature, multi-cultural literature, cultures, and mathematics.
